description.en: Live marbled liquid fills each feature card from your entry point and drains toward your exit. Each card has its own three-color palette.
description.zh: 实时液体纹理从鼠标进入的位置铺满卡片，再向离开的位置收拢。每张卡片拥有独立的三色色板。

keywords: 液体 注入 卡片 网格 三色 着色器 悬浮 方向 shader flood liquid feature cards hover palette seed Planes Ashish Gogula

discovery.caveat: 独立程序化重建；支持自定义项目和三色色板，不包含付费原始源码。

source.implementation: Independent framework-neutral DOM/WebGL1 renderer with procedural domain-warp noise, Canvas2D fallback and six native framework lifecycle wrappers. No author shader, paid source, footage, raster texture or remote font is distributed.
source.license: Original design rights remain with Ashish Gogula / Planes. Pro source is not included or accessed; no redistribution permission is claimed. Independently authored rendering and lifecycle. Lucide icons retain their ISC notice. Reference video and extracted frames stay internal.

notice.en: Complete source files from this project's existing framework package. Preserve included notices and reference attribution.
notice.zh: 提供本站已有框架代码包的完整文件，保留源码声明与设计参考署名。

instructions.en: Hover from any side to fill a card and move out to drain it. On touch screens, tap to toggle; use Tab and arrow keys to navigate, Escape to close.
instructions.zh: 从任意方向移入展开，移出收拢；触屏轻触切换。Tab 与方向键导航，Escape 收起。
